headline: Kai, October PCE lands at 8:30 with a December hike 98% priced — and the market is selling chips first, asking questions later.
subline: Core PCE is expected at 3.2%, Nasdaq-100 futures are off 2.5% with semis leading lower, and bitcoin sits under $59,000 ahead of Thursday's holiday close.
asof: Pre-market futures · as of 6:35 AM ET · every figure links to its source below

items.title: PCE, GDP and jobless claims all land this morning
items.sentence: October core PCE is expected at 3.2% year over year with traders pricing a 98% chance of a quarter-point December hike, per Yahoo Finance, which lists Q3 GDP, durable goods and new home sales on the same pre-holiday slate.

items.title: Chip selloff drags into a second session
items.sentence: Nvidia fell 5.9% Tuesday and the S&P 500 closed at 7,201.09 as Monday's reinstatement rally kept reversing, per Stock Market Watch's digest, with Nasdaq-100 futures down another 2.5% this morning per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Brent back above $88 after Ras Tanura strike
items.sentence: Houthi forces confirmed attacks on Saudi Arabia's 550k-bpd Ras Tanura refinery and Iran's army claimed two US drones downed near Hormuz, per Newsquawk, which has Brent trading back above $88 intraday.

items.title: Bitcoin extends its slide to $58,900
items.sentence: Fortune's tracker puts the coin roughly 25% below where it stood a month ago and about half its October 2025 peak of $126,198. Yahoo Finance shows it at $58,882 pre-market, down another 1.4% overnight.

items.title: Deere reports before a holiday-shortened tape
items.sentence: The equipment maker is the morning's marquee print, per Yahoo Finance, with US markets closed Thursday for Thanksgiving and open a half-day Friday.

items.title: US prepares higher tariffs on China and EU
items.sentence: The Journal reports new rates on China, the EU and 14 other partners following an industrial-overcapacity investigation, with the EU, Japan and South Korea likely facing 15% or less.

items.title: Houthis hit Riyadh's PIF tower a second time
items.sentence: Eleven people were injured in the second strike on the Public Investment Fund headquarters in under a week, per Al Jazeera.

items.title: Venezuela reveals $237.5 billion debt pile
items.sentence: The disclosure sets up one of the largest sovereign debt restructurings on record, Bloomberg reports.

items.title: Shanghai party chief under corruption investigation
items.sentence: Chen Jining is the fourth member of the 2022 Politburo cohort placed under investigation for suspected discipline violations, per the South China Morning Post.

items.title: Pakistan's first astronaut heads to Tiangong
items.sentence: Shenzhou-24 lifted off carrying Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, set to become the first foreign crew member aboard China's space station, per the Associated Press.

items.title: Congress fumes as Huang testimony nears
items.sentence: Lawmakers from both parties questioned the board's no-security-risk finding ahead of the December 3 Senate Banking hearing, per PBS NewsHour; Trump called a pardon "always an option," per Yahoo Finance.

items.title: Jury convicts Huawei on 10 of 12 counts
items.sentence: A New York federal jury found the company guilty of bank fraud and trade-secret conspiracy while acquitting it on the most serious charges, per Reuters.

items.title: Google ships Gemini 4 Neon, its fourth in seven weeks
items.sentence: Artificial Analysis scores Neon third on its Intelligence Index behind OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2, at $3 per million input tokens.

items.title: Brussels floats €50 billion sovereign tech fund
items.sentence: The European Commission proposed the equity vehicle for quantum technology bets, per Newsquawk's morning briefing.
